findings.summary: A holder that dies between mkdir and writing the pid file leaves a lock with an empty holder; waiters poll the full 300s and the lock never self-clears.
findings.title: ai-sdlc-plugin/scripts/install-runtime-deps.sh: a holder that dies between mkdir and writing the pid file leaves a lock with an empty holder; waiters poll the full 300s and the lock never self-clears.

findings.summary: An unhealthy tree removes the whole node_modules/@ai-sdlc; deliberate clean reinstall, a missing HEALTH_SCRIPT or failing node call also triggers it.
findings.title: ai-sdlc-plugin/scripts/install-runtime-deps.sh: an unhealthy tree removes the whole node_modules/@ai-sdlc; deliberate clean reinstall, a missing health_script or failing node call also triggers it.

findings.summary: The closure walk follows only dependencies of @ai-sdlc packages; optional or peer deps are not checked. Note the scope in the comment.

findings.summary: Race when reclaiming a stale lock: two waiters can both reclaim and run two installs at once; re-read the pid before removing. A non-numeric AI_SDLC_INSTALL_LOCK_TIMEOUT ends the script after one wait.
